<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"><style>*, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {
      --blue: #007FEB;
      --blue-light: #4DA3F0;
      --green: #03B01E;
      --green-hover: #029a18;
      --dark: #0A0A0B;
      --dark-2: #111113;
      --dark-3: #1A1A1D;
      --off-white: #F5F5F7;
      --card-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      --card-border: rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      --text-primary: #1D1D1F;
      --text-secondary: #86868B;
      --radius: 24px;
      --radius-btn: 50px;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      background: var(--off-white);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* ===== BODY TEXT STANDARD ===== */
    p, li, .faq-answer, .t-card p, .bento-list li, .ps-list li, .timeline-content p, .bento-card-wide p, .why-footer-text p {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 400;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
    }
    @keyframes scaleIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.9); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; }
      50% { opacity: 0.8; }
    }
    @keyframes marquee {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(40px);
      transition: opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }
    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
    .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
    .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
    .reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: 0.4s; }

    .reveal-scale {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(0.92);
      transition: opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }
    .reveal-scale.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1);
    }

    /* ===== BUTTONS ===== */
    .btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--green);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 18px 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-btn);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .btn-primary::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.12), transparent);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(3,176,30,0.35);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: transparent;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 18px 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-btn);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    }
    .btn-outline:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      background: var(--dark);
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url('https://rodrigomaranhao.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/1-1.webp') center right / cover no-repeat;
    }
    .hero .container {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0 24px 0 400px;
    }
    .hero-content {
      max-width: 550px;
    }
    .hero-badges {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.2s both;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-btn);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: 52px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -2.5px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.3s both;
    }
    .hero h1 .gradient-text {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue), var(--blue-light));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 400;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      max-width: 520px;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.4s both;
    }
    .hero-subtitle strong {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .hero-buttons {
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.5s both;
    }

    /* ===== INTRO (NOVA SECAO) ===== */
    .intro {
      background: var(--off-white);
      padding: 80px 0;
      position: relative;
    }
    .intro .container {
      max-width: 1060px;
    }
    .intro-content {
      text-align: center;
      background: #fff;
      padding: 56px 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
    }
    .intro-content p {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.8;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .intro-content p:first-child {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .intro-checks {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 32px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 36px;
    }
    .intro-check {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .intro-check svg {
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* ===== SECTIONS COMMON ===== */
    section { padding: 60px 0; }
    .hero { padding: 0; }
    .section-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: 48px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      line-height: 1.08;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .section-header .section-subtitle { margin: 0 auto; }

    /* ===== PROBLEMA / SOLUCAO ===== */
    .problem-solution { background: var(--off-white); overflow: hidden; }
    .ps-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    }
    .ps-side { padding: 56px 48px; }
    .ps-side.problem { background: var(--dark); color: #fff; }
    .ps-side.solution { background: #fff; }
    .ps-side-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 2.5px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .ps-side.problem .ps-side-label { color: #ff6b6b; }
    .ps-side.solution .ps-side-label { color: var(--green); }
    .ps-side h3 {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }
    .ps-list {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
    }
    .ps-list li {
      font-size: 15px;
      padding-left: 32px;
      position: relative;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .ps-list li::before {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
    }
    .ps-side.problem .ps-list li { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }
    .ps-side.problem .ps-list li::before { content: '\2717'; color: #ff6b6b; }
    .ps-side.solution .ps-list li { color: var(--text-secondary); }
    .ps-side.solution .ps-list li::before { content: '\2713'; color: var(--green); }
    .ps-note {
      font-size: 13px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      opacity: 0.5;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .ps-cta-row {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    /* ===== PROCESSO — TIMELINE ===== */
    .process {
      background: var(--dark);
      color: #fff;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .process::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      width: 800px;
      height: 800px;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,127,235,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .process .section-title { color: #fff; }
    .process .section-subtitle { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }
    .process .section-label { color: var(--blue-light); }
    .timeline {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .timeline::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 28px;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--blue), rgba(0,127,235,0.1));
    }
    .timeline-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 36px;
      padding-bottom: 48px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .timeline-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
    .timeline-dot {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      background: var(--dark-3);
      border: 2px solid var(--blue);
      border-radius: 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--blue);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      transition: all 0.4s;
    }
    .timeline-item:hover .timeline-dot {
      background: var(--blue);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,127,235,0.3);
    }
    .timeline-content { padding-top: 12px; }
    .timeline-content h3 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .timeline-content p {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .process-cta { text-align: center; margin-top: 64px; }
    .process-note {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 16px;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    }

    /* ===== TIPOS SOCIEDADE — BENTO ===== */
    .types { background: var(--off-white); }
    .bento-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: auto auto;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .bento-card {
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 44px 36px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
    }
    .bento-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .bento-card::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--blue-light));
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.4s;
    }
    .bento-card:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
    .bento-card .type-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      color: var(--blue);
      background: rgba(0,127,235,0.08);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .bento-card h3 {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .bento-list {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .bento-list li {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      padding-left: 28px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .bento-list li::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 7px;
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--blue);
      opacity: 0.5;
    }
    .bento-card-wide {
      grid-column: span 3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--dark) 0%, var(--dark-3) 100%);
      color: #fff;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 40px 48px;
    }
    .bento-card-wide:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }
    .bento-card-wide::after { display: none; }
    .bento-card-wide p {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      max-width: 500px;
    }

    /* ===== SOCIAL PROOF / DEPOIMENTOS ===== */
    .testimonials {
      background: var(--off-white);
      position: relative;
    }
    .testimonial-marquee {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow: hidden;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 10%, #000 90%, transparent);
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 10%, #000 90%, transparent);
    }
    .testimonial-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      animation: marquee 30s linear infinite;
    }
    .t-card {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 380px;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 36px 32px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
    }
    .t-card-quote {
      font-size: 32px;
      color: var(--blue);
      opacity: 0.3;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .t-card p {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .t-card-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
    .t-card-avatar {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .t-card-avatar.av-1 { background: var(--blue); }
    .t-card-avatar.av-2 { background: #8B5CF6; }
    .t-card-avatar.av-3 { background: var(--green); }
    .t-card-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }
    .t-card-role { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); }

    /* ===== POR QUE ESCOLHER ===== */
    .why-us {
      background: var(--dark);
      color: #fff;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .why-us::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -200px;
      right: -200px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(0,127,235,0.06);
      filter: blur(100px);
    }
    .why-us .section-title { color: #fff; }
    .why-us .section-label { color: var(--blue-light); }
    @keyframes neonPulse {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,127,235,0.3), 0 0 60px rgba(0,127,235,0.1), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,127,235,0.05); }
      50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,127,235,0.5), 0 0 80px rgba(0,127,235,0.2), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,127,235,0.08); }
    }
    @keyframes borderRotate {
      0% { --angle: 0deg; }
      100% { --angle: 360deg; }
    }
    .why-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 420px 1fr;
      gap: 56px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .why-photo {
      position: sticky;
      top: 100px;
      padding: 1px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue), rgba(0,127,235,0.2), var(--blue-light), rgba(0,127,235,0.2), var(--blue));
      background-size: 300% 300%;
      animation: neonPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite, gradientShift 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes gradientShift {
      0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
      50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    }
    .why-photo img {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
      border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 1px);
    }
    .why-items {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .why-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 20px;
      padding: 28px 24px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      transition: background 0.4s;
    }
    .why-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
    .why-icon-wrap {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      background: rgba(0,127,235,0.1);
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all 0.4s;
    }
    .why-item:hover .why-icon-wrap {
      background: var(--blue);
      transform: scale(1.1);
    }
    .why-icon-wrap svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; color: var(--blue); transition: color 0.4s; }
    .why-item:hover .why-icon-wrap svg { color: #fff; }
    .why-item h4 {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .why-item-text p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .why-footer-text { text-align: center; margin-top: 56px; }
    .why-footer-text p {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .why-footer-text strong {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* ===== FAQ ===== */
    .faq { background: var(--off-white); }
    .faq-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .faq-left { position: sticky; top: 120px; }
    .faq-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
    .faq-item {
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      transition: box-shadow 0.3s;
    }
    .faq-item:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); }
    .faq-question {
      width: 100%;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      padding: 22px 28px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .faq-question:hover { color: var(--blue); }
    .faq-icon {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--off-white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all 0.3s;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .faq-item.active .faq-icon {
      background: var(--blue);
      color: #fff;
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }
    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }
    .faq-item.active .faq-answer { max-height: 200px; }
    .faq-answer p {
      padding: 0 28px 22px;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal, .reveal-scale').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

    // FAQ
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const item = btn.parentElement;
        const wasActive = item.classList.contains('active');
        document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('active'));
        if (!wasActive) item.classList.add('active');
      });
    });

    // Smooth scroll
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const target = document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));
        if (target) target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      });
    });</script>
